purpose: Independently judge the combined mobile/touch repair and Go performance outcome with both focused checks and baseline/candidate measurements.

execution.instructions: Require complete structured request/seed/phase/work evidence for the investigation; report evidence_status alone is not proof of completeness. Missing sidecars or truncated stdout cannot prove the original failure resolved. Independently review BOTH original authorized outcomes: Vue/mobile interaction repair and scoped Go performance investigation. Inspect the retained cumulative patch, actual frontend-check artifact, focused Go check, committed-source baseline and candidate measurement artifacts. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md. Read affected source/contracts only as needed to judge completeness, correctness, generated ownership, compatibility and meaningful regression coverage. Require complete request/seed/work evidence and a supported cause/fix under the unchanged single 10-second deadline; passing small diagnostic controls, a timing difference or additional instrumentation alone cannot resolve the lost timeout. Failed or absent samples remain failures. Preserve identities, difficulty/uniqueness, work/cancellation bounds, public validation and saves. Require source-level mobile coverage for initial board entry, actual board/control fit or accessible intentional zoom, real touch drawing plus two-corner fallback, reachable commit/Undo and reload; downstream built-image Chromium/WebKit qualification still must prove the rendered journeys. Preserve desktop behavior. Source is read-only: do not edit, retest, use Git, launch agents or perform external work. Return ready with verdict exactly APPROVE only when both requested outcomes have a complete source handoff and sufficient supplied focused proof. Concrete in-scope repairs return changes_requested with verdict BLOCKED. Missing capability, infrastructure uncertainty, a required material decision or unresolved cause/safe fix returns blocked with verdict BLOCKED. Do not waive proof or widen scope. Keep findings and missing proof in at most 240 characters.
